name: pm-product-strategy
description: Drafts a product strategy kernel with a diagnosis, a guiding policy, coherent actions and a "we will not" list, checked against the signs of bad strategy. Use for "run pm-product-strategy", "write our product strategy", "strategy one-pager", "we have no strategy to say no against", "everything is high priority", "what will we not do", "turn our goals into a real strategy", part of the AI for Product Management Pack by 90n.
